verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:

"Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: In your proud heart you say, "I am a god. I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the sea." But you are only a man and not a god, even though you think you are as wise as a god.
You think you are wiser than Daniel, and that no secret is hidden from you.
By your wisdom and understanding you have made yourself rich. You have filled your treasuries with gold and silver.
By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and because of your wealth your heart has grown proud.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you think you are as wise as a god,
I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against your beautiful wisdom and stain your splendor.
They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the sea.
Will you still say "I am a god" in front of the one who kills you? You will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of those who strike you down.
You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. For I have spoken, says the Lord GOD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, sing a funeral song for the king of Tyre and say to him, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: You were the model of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone covered you: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald. Your settings and mountings were made of gold. They were prepared on the day you were created.
You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had appointed you. You were on the holy mountain of God, and you walked among the fiery stones.
You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created until wickedness was found in you.
Through your widespread trading you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mountain of God. I expelled you, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
Your heart became proud because of your beauty. You corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the ground. I made you a spectacle in front of kings.
By your many sins and dishonest trade you dishonored your holy places. So I made a fire come out from you, and it burned you up. I turned you to ashes on the ground in the sight of everyone watching.
All the nations who knew you are shocked at what has happened to you. You have come to a terrible end and will be no more.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her.
Say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will show my glory among you. People will know that I am the LORD when I punish her and show my holiness in her.
I will send disease on her and make blood flow in her streets. The dead will fall inside her, as the sword attacks her from every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
The people of Israel will no longer have hostile neighbors who are like painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'

This is what the Lord GOD says: 'When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will show my holiness through them while the nations watch. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

They will live there in safety. They will build houses and plant vineyards. They will live in safety when I punish all their neighbors who treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.'"
